svg.title: Landauer erasure bound versus temperature
svg.desc: What this figure shows: The minimum work associated with logically irreversible one-bit erasure scales linearly with absolute temperature. The plotted object is generated from W_erase >= k_B T ln 2. How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Established thermodynamic bound. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
